composer.noteLocal: This exercise doesn't call a model or need a model connection. A local runner executes it.
composer.runtimeLocale: This lesson's runner only speaks {{language}} for now: its questions, prompts and run events are in {{language}}.
composer.stopping: Stopping: the server was asked to stop; waiting for it to record how the run ended.
composer.detach: Disconnect the event stream (the run goes on)

answer.title: Final answer
answer.waitingModel: Waiting for the model to finish the task…
answer.waitingLocal: Waiting for the local program to finish the task…
answer.emptyReplay: During replay, this stays in sync with the selected position.
answer.runLocale: This run was recorded in {{language}}: its question, prompts and events stay in {{language}} when you replay it.
answer.resumedFrom: This run resumed from checkpoint “{{name}}” of run {{run}}: nothing of the old run was replayed, and every request here is a new one.

stream.receiving: Streaming: the text of the {{chunks}} chunks that have arrived so far.
stream.completed: The stream ended after {{chunks}} chunks; the final answer is the run's answer event.
stream.stopped: The lesson code stopped receiving after {{chunks}} chunks.
stream.cancelled: The run was stopped: only the {{chunks}} chunks received before the stop are here; later chunks were not recorded.
stream.error: The stream broke off: these are the {{chunks}} chunks received before the error.

replay.footnote: Replay only reads this run record. It never calls the model again.

event.custom: Custom lesson event · click for full data

list.title: Execution order
list.emptyHint: After a run, the steps appear here in order.
list.rewoundHint: Play the replay or step forward.

detail.title: Request and response
detail.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the data and copy it manually.
detail.sdk: SDK-standardized data. Not the same as the raw HTTP message.
detail.http: Full HTTP request or response data. You can inspect messages, tools, and tool_call_id.
detail.embeddingHttp: Full HTTP request or response data. You can inspect each text in input and the vectors returned.
detail.generic: Full execution data for the current event.
detail.emptyLine1: Run a question on the left, then select an event.
detail.emptyLine2: The full request, response, or tool result shows here.
detail.embeddingTruncated: Vectors show only their first {{count}} numbers. The display is truncated; the record is complete, and the copy button copies the full JSON.
detail.streamDelta: Stream chunks: the provider's chunks recorded unchanged, in arrival order. Chunks that arrive within a short interval share one event so there are not too many events; no chunk is dropped.
detail.streamAssembled: The full response the platform assembled from {{count}} chunks, not a single response body the provider sent. data.stream records the first-chunk time, how the stream ended and why it stopped.
detail.streamHttp: Bailian native HTTP: each chunk is the JSON of one SSE data line, with the SSE framing removed.
detail.streamSdk: LiteLLM: each chunk is the SDK's standardized chunk object, not the provider's raw SSE line.
detail.approval: Approval record: the request holds the complete payload awaiting approval and its digest; the result says who decided what, and when. Replays are read-only and cannot approve again.
detail.checkpoint: Checkpoint: the execution position and state the lesson saved. It is kept in the run record and survives a server restart.
detail.resumeHint: You can start a new run from this checkpoint; the old run's requests are not replayed.

toast.completedDetail_one: {{count}} real event · {{seconds}} s on the server
toast.completedDetail_other: {{count}} real events · {{seconds}} s on the server
toast.errorFallback: Check the error event in the trace.

extension.unavailable: The custom view for the {{slot}} is unavailable, so the generic UI is shown. Lesson content and run records still work.
extension.failed: The custom view for the {{slot}} failed to load, so the generic UI is shown. Lesson content and run records still work.

evidence.title: Lab report
evidence.sync: Follows the run evidence and replay
evidence.empty: Run an exercise to see this lesson's checks, comparison data, and conclusions.
evidence.rawLabel: View the raw events of the report
evidence.truncated: This is a summary. The full data is in the raw record.

toolOutcomes.title: Tool results and safety boundaries
toolOutcomes.source: Real tool results at the current replay position
toolOutcomes.empty: No tool results yet. Run or replay forward to see which requests were accepted and which the tools rejected.

inputs.title: Lab parameters
inputs.help: Parameters are generated from this lesson's input model, and the backend validates them again before a run. Switching exercises loads that exercise's default parameters.
inputs.unsupported: This parameter can't be edited with a control yet. Switch to JSON editing.

approval.title: Approval: {{kind}}
approval.remaining: {{seconds}} s left (timed by the server's deadline; then it counts as a timeout)
approval.noteLabel: Reason (optional, written into the run record)
approval.notePlaceholder: For example: path checked, OK to write
approval.editHint: You approve the payload as you edited it; the edit is recorded next to the original.
approval.editSyntax: The JSON is malformed; check the quotes, commas and brackets.
approval.editNotObject: The payload must be a JSON object.
approval.sentApprove: “Approve” sent; waiting for the run to record the decision.
approval.sentReject: “Reject” sent; waiting for the run to record the decision.
approval.notLive: You cannot decide while the event stream is disconnected or the run is stopping; reconnect first.
approval.replayPending: At this point of the replay the run is waiting for approval. Replays are read-only.
